turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
your rug the very first time:
menu
• Unroll and flatten: Unroll the rug and let it lay flat for 36 to 48 hours to relax naturally. You can smooth out any shipping bends using your hands or the rug tube.
• Place a rug pad: Place a non-skid rug pad underneath on hard surfaces to prevent slipping and protect your flooring.
• Cleaning & vacuuming: Vacuum using a hard-surface attachment without a beater bar. For spills, spot clean with mild soap and water.
